taa.line.width.tooltip: SSAA line width multiplier: 0.1 to 4.0, default 1.0. 0.5 halves the width; 2.0 doubles it. Apply or Done commits the value.
taa.line.width.invalid: Enter a line width multiplier from 0.1 to 4.0
taa.gui.entity.tooltip: Apply SSAA to inventory characters and vanilla GUI entity previews using the selected SSAA scale. Text and item icons stay unchanged.
taa.title: Anti-aliasing Settings
taa.ssaa.tooltip: 4x, 9x and 16x render at 2, 3 and 4 times each dimension, then downsample. Covers world and hands without history blending. High scales significantly increase GPU load.
taa.ssaa.failed: SSAA failed; lower scale or press F3+T
taa.ssaa.limit: SSAA resolution exceeds GPU limit; lower scale
taa.status.failed: Render failure; check log or press F3+T
taa.debug.tooltip: Current frame includes jitter for debugging. Disable TAA to compare vanilla.
taa.history.tooltip: History weight ranges from 0 to 1, default 0.97. 100% relies more on previous frames.
taa.sharpen.tooltip: Unsharp defaults to 0.20. CAS has a separate amount.
taa.samples.tooltip: Enter an integer from 1 to 256. Apply or Done commits the value.
taa.samples.invalid: Enter a frame count from 1 to 256
taa.motion.tooltip: On: reduces weight with pixel movement. Off: keeps the configured weight for valid history.
